interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Thu:[/b][/color] [b]One beer[/b], please. I closed the stall early.

response_choices: Why did you close early, Thu?

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Thu:[/b][/color] Nobody wanted a drink once the police arrived.
[color=#ffffff][b]Thu:[/b][/color] They found someone in the drainage channel beyond the alley. They put up a sheet before I could see.
[color=#ffffff][b]Thu:[/b][/color] I keep thinking about Binh asking for his receipt. I wish I had listened.
